name: Hearty Tortellini Pasta e Fagioli

instructions.primary_message: Heat the oil in a stockpot over medium heat and add the vegetables. Season with salt and pepper, and stir often until the onion is translucent, about 4 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and broth, and bring to a rolling boil. Add the beans and ham tortellini, cover and cook until the tortellini are just cooked (follow package directions, about 2 minutes). Ladle into bowls and top with Parmesan and prosciutto.

schema_metadata.keywords: Dinner for Two, Italian, pasta i fagioli, quick, soup, tortellini

description: This thick, tomatoey soup is stuffed with veggies, creamy white beans, and, for a twist, prosciutto-stuffed baby tortellini.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 small carrot, chopped (optional); 2 small celery stalks, chopped (optional); 1/2 small onion, chopped (optional); Grated Parmesan to garnish; Thinly sliced prosciutto to garnish (optional)

Optional substitutions: tomato basil sauce → marinara sauce; vegetable broth → chicken broth
author: Kerry Saretsky
